description: Dead-man for the snapshot-probe watchdog (sensor.camera_health) itself. Its alert automation's four template triggers all read state_attr(...)|int(0), so a dead/unknown sensor - or the script's own error path, which publishes healthy=-1 with zeroed counts - evaluates as 'no fault' on every one of them: the primary liveness monitor could die and be reported as a clean fleet (observed: 10 recorder rows of 'unknown' with all json_attributes wiped). 30 min clears restart windows. RE-ASSERTS hourly (:53) while dead (restart-wipe guard). Added 2026-08-17.
